description: Returns up to 10 data series that might answer a data question, each labelled with the publisher's title, place (code and level), unit, frequency, latest value, range, source and licence, and the call_api arguments that return exactly that series. Never returns a value on its own guess: status is "candidates" or "none" (with a reason). When to use: for a data question, pass query or the parts measure, place and period; then choose a candidate whose measure, place and time match the question and pass its call_api arguments to call_api. If none matches, tell the user this service does not have it. Read-only, no API key or signup. Free quota: 1000 calls/day per IP, shared across tools.

measure.description: What is measured, e.g. "unemployment rate" (with place and period: used instead of query)

place.description: Place name or code, e.g. "California" or "US-CA"

query.description: The question in plain text, max 500 characters

name: find_data
title: Find candidate data series
